title: swiftDialog Inspect Mode Configuration
description: Configuration schema for swiftDialog's Inspect mode presets (preset1-preset7; preset7 runs on the preset5 engine). Used with: dialog --inspect-mode --inspect-config <path>.

x-ipc-protocol.description: IPC command protocol for controlling Dialog at runtime via trigger file or DistributedNotifications

channels.com.swiftdialog.command: External -> Dialog: send commands (ignitecli ipc send)
channels.com.swiftdialog.event: Dialog -> External: lifecycle events (ready, exit, step_changed, button_click, selection)
channels.com.swiftdialog.ack: Dialog -> External: command acknowledgments with stepId and status
channels.com.ignitecli.command: Also observed by Dialog for ignitecli interop

navigation.reset: Reset all progress and return to first step

completion.success:<stepId>:<message>: Mark step as successful with optional message
completion.failure:<stepId>:<reason>: Mark step as failed with optional reason
completion.complete:<stepId>: Mark step as complete (no result state)

content_updates.update_guidance:<stepId>:<blockIndex>:<p: Update a guidance block property (state, actual, label, content, visible, progress, etc.)
content_updates.update_guidance:<stepId>:<blockId>:<prop: Same but resolve block by ID instead of index

badges.badge:<blockId>:<state>: Shorthand: update a status-badge state by block ID (resolves across all steps)

selections.select:<key>:<value1,value2>: Set selection values for a dropdown/radio/grid by key

validation.recheck:<itemId>: Re-evaluate monitors for a specific item

shorthand_notifications.description: Commands sent via DistributedNotification are expanded to JSON shorthand: 'success:edge:Installed' becomes {"success": "edge:Installed"}.

lifecycle_events.ready: Posted when Dialog is initialized and ready for commands. Readiness file written to readinessFile path with JSON: {pid, triggerFile, timestamp, ackChannel, preset, itemCount, items}
lifecycle_events.exit: Posted when Dialog closes. Includes exitCode, completedCount, failedCount, totalSteps, resultFile
lifecycle_events.defer: Posted when user selects a deferral option. Exit code 10, result file contains deferDuration and deferSeconds
lifecycle_events.step_changed: Posted when user navigates to a different step. Includes stepId
lifecycle_events.button_click: Posted when user clicks a button. Includes stepId, label, action
lifecycle_events.selection: Posted when user makes a selection. Includes key, values

ignitecli_commands.ignitecli ipc wait-ready [--timeout N]: Wait for Dialog ready event (notification-first, file fallback)
ignitecli_commands.ignitecli ipc wait-step <stepId> [--time: Wait for user to navigate to a step

status_badge_pattern.description: status-badge displays label (top, bold) + actual or state (bottom, colored). Use state for semantic coloring and actual for the display value.
status_badge_pattern.example_dynamic_update: ignitecli ipc batch --step hw --json '{"0": {"state": "success", "actual": "Apple M4 Max"}}'

critical_pattern.description: Pre-load data before navigating. Dialog's dynamicState buffers writes for any step; data sent after navigation arrives mid-animation and renders late.
critical_pattern.correct: ignitecli ipc batch --step step3 --json '{...}' && ignitecli ipc send next
critical_pattern.wrong: ignitecli ipc send next && ignitecli ipc batch --step step3 --json '{...}'

preset4_toast_installer.description: Compact toast showing app installation progress
preset4_toast_installer.script: ignitecli ipc inspect config.json && ignitecli ipc wait-ready && ignitecli ipc send 'success:slack:Done' && ignitecli ipc send 'success:zoom:Done'

preset6_sysinfo_dashboard.description: Sidebar dashboard with live system info via status-badge actual values
preset6_sysinfo_dashboard.script: ignitecli sysinfo all > /tmp/info.json && ignitecli ipc inspect config.json

deferral_flow.description: Update prompt with 'Not Now' deferral menu (exit code 10)

dynamic_batch_update.description: Update multiple status badges atomically after running checks
dynamic_batch_update.script: ignitecli ipc batch --step checks --json '{"0": {"state": "success", "actual": "192.168.1.123"}, "1": {"state": "fail", "actual": "8 GB free (need 20)"}, "2": {"progress": "0.66", "label": "Checking..."}}'

ignitecli_tools.description: Example system tools that produce data for Dialog badges.

tools.ignitecli sysinfo all: JSON with hardware, disk, network, os, user info
tools.ignitecli check all --step <id>: Run network/storage/OS checks with auto badge updates

watch.description: Reload this config file whenever it is saved, staying on the current step; for authoring. An invalid save keeps the last good version with a banner naming the problem. Leave it out of a deployed config.

$schema.description: Where an editor finds this schema (a path or URL to inspect-config.schema.json), for autocomplete and checks. Ignored by Dialog.

accentBorderColor.description: Top accent border color for branded presets (hex format, e.g., '#DC0A15')

actionPipe.description: Optional FIFO path for instant script request delivery

autoAdvanceDelay.description: Preset 6 only: seconds before auto-advancing to the next step (default 0.5). Not the image-carousel block's autoAdvanceDelay, which is the interval between slides.

autoAdvanceOnComplete.description: Preset6: Auto-navigate to next step after marking complete

backButtonStyle.description: Back button placement: 'inline' (inside scroll content) | 'footer' (in footer bar)

appearance.description: Force the inspect window appearance: 'dark' or 'light' override the OS; omit or 'auto' to follow the system setting.

banner.description: Banner image path (overrides icon in some presets)

brandPaletteDark.description: The same palette slots for dark appearance. Falls back per key to brandPalette, so author only the slots that differ. Omit for one palette in both appearances.

brandPaletteRef.description: Read the brand palette (role -> hex dictionary at 'key', dark set at 'darkKey') from a managed preference. The profile wins per role; inline 'brandPalette' is the fallback. Non-string values are ignored.

brands.description: Available brand options for brand picker step (multi-brand onboarding)

button1symbol.description: SF Symbol for the primary button, in the classic --button1symbol grammar: 'name[,leading|trailing|top|bottom][,monochrome|hierarchical|multicolor|palette][,size=N][,colo(u)r=X][,palette=a-b-c]'. Default color inherits the button label.

button2symbol.description: SF Symbol for the secondary button, same grammar as button1symbol

cacheExtensions.description: File extensions within cachePaths that mark an item as downloading (default ['download', 'pkg', 'dmg']). Add others for non-curl downloaders, e.g. 'aria2' for aria2c partial files. Leading dot optional.

windowPosition.description: Anchor the window at launch (Preset 4 toast): topleft, top, topright, left, center, right, bottomleft, bottom, bottomright. Absent = default placement.

options.description: General window flags set from the config, the same as their command-line forms. Only a true value acts, and a flag given on the command line wins; a config cannot switch a flag off. Unlisted keys are ignored with a log line.

moveable.description: The same as --moveable: the window can be dragged.

ontop.description: The same as --ontop: the window floats above other windows and follows the user across Spaces.

resizable.description: The same as --resizable: the window can be resized.

windowbuttons.description: The same as --windowbuttons: which title-bar buttons to show, as a comma-separated list of min, max, close ("min,max"); true shows all three.

button1Action.description: What the primary button does where it would close Dialog: 'exit' (default) or 'minimize' (send the window to the Dock). On Presets 5 and 7 it applies to the last step's Continue unless that step sets continueAction.

button2Action.description: What the secondary button does where it would close Dialog with exit code 2: 'exit' (default) or 'minimize', which sends the window to the Dock instead.

windowPositionOffset.description: Edge offset in points for the launch windowPosition anchor

completedTitle.description: Preset 3: replaces the main-phase title once all items are complete (supports {userName}). Localizable via the localization key 'completedTitle'.

greetingNameSource.description: Preset 3: managed-preference reference (domain and key) holding the user's display name for the {userName} greeting. Falls back to the local user's real name.

key.description: Key within that domain holding the display name

debugMode.description: Debug/testing mode - ignore completion flags, always start from step 1 (preserves form values)

density.description: Type size tier: 'standard' (default) or 'comfortable' (fonts 10% larger; layout unchanged). Step content honours it on Presets 5 and 7; intro/outro screens on every preset except 4.

enableOnTimer.description: Seconds after launch to auto-enable a disabled primary button (one-shot; requires button1disabled: true). Independent of autoEnableButton.

receiptsBasePath.description: Base directory for `receipt` requirements (default /var/db/receipts). Overridable so test fixtures can fake receipts without root

receiptCensus.description: Complete rows by counting receipts: receipts that appear in receiptsBasePath (default /var/db/receipts) after launch each complete the next pending row in list order. Never uncompletes a row.

eventFile.description: Path to write JSONL step events (step_started, step_completed, etc.)

finalButtonText.description: Button text when all items complete

footerTextColor.description: Footer text color (hex format, for dark backgrounds)

guidanceContent.description: Content blocks in the plain-branded shell's content column. Supports 'text'/'paragraph', 'bullets', 'info', 'image', 'image-carousel', 'button' and 'stepper'; other types are dropped with an advisory.

iconBasePath.description: Base path for relative icon paths

introSteps.description: Array of intro steps for Preset5 intro wizard flow

steps.description: The step list. On a preset-6 config `items[]` is the same list under its older name; both spellings decode, `steps` is the one to author.

items.description: Array of item configurations (used by preset1-6)

labels.description: Unified labels: one flat key-value map for all Dialog UI text, merging uiLabels, complianceLabels and pickerLabels. Takes precedence over those structs. Supports inline translations.

translations.description: Inline translations keyed by language code (e.g., 'de', 'fr'). Each value is a flat key-value map of label overrides.

topBand.description: Flow-level top band (card chrome): device render, claim, or brand mark. Optional. All steps or nothing: one conflicting step suppresses it flow-wide with an advisory.

flavor.description: claim absorbs the header (full-strength gradient); device and logo ride the clamped wash

height.description: Band height in points. Claim band: default 200 (h/3), clamp 100-220, window stays 820x600. Device/logo band: default 118, clamp 100-118, window 820x680.

image.description: device: the render; logo: overrides logoConfig

ground.description: device/logo ground; claim always paints full-strength gradient

groundImage.description: cover-filled into the measured box; wash fallback on load failure

message.description: The fixed line under the title: Presets 1 (every shell), 2, 3 and 6, and Preset 4 in its info style with no items. Presets 5 and 7 use a step's own title and subtitle instead.

observeOnly.description: Global observe-only mode - disables all user interactions

overlayicon.description: Overlay icon for brand identity badges

pickerConfig.description: Preset 5 guide picker (3.1.1): steps with selectable: true get a Select button; Finish waits for a selection and, with returnSelections, writes a plist of selectedItem (single) or selectedItems[] + selectionCount (multi), each {id, title}.

returnSelections.description: Write the selections plist at Finish

preset.description: The preset layout. Aliases: preset1/1/deployment, preset2/2/cards, preset3/3/compact, preset4/4/toast/compact-installer, preset5/5/portal/self-service/webview-portal, preset6/6/guidance/modern-sidebar, preset7/7/guided-setup/guided (runs on the preset5 engine).

progressBarConfig.description: Status colors for the shared progress footer: when present, normal/complete/blocking/error override the highlight tint per install state. Absent = highlight color only.

progressMode.description: Preset4: 'shared' (single bar, X of Y) | 'perItem' (indeterminate per item) | 'report' (all items as a scrollable check-report list; persists until Done)

messageStyle.description: Preset 4: 'info' shows one info card per item instead of an installer (displayName = title, subtitle = context, icon = glyph, claim = answer in inline markdown, continueButtonText = button, default 'Got it'). Without items, one card from introScreen and the root message.

readinessFile.description: Path to write readiness signal JSON (default: '{triggerFile}.ready'). Written when preset is ready for commands.

resultFile.description: Path to write a JSON result on exit: exit code, selections, form values, and one entry per step with its status (completed with result success/failure and a failureReason, skipped, or pending). Item presets (1-3) report each item as an entry of stepType 'item'.

profileLook.description: Runs a dictionary of the look profile (domain au.csiro.dialog.setup) under this config, e.g. 'firstLogin'. Only for a config with no look of its own.

showProfilesRow.description: Fleet log monitor: show the one "Configuration profiles" row summing up the team's profiles. false leaves profiles out of the list.

resumable.description: Opt-in state persistence: when true, saves progress and resumes on relaunch

rotatingImages.description: Array of image paths for rotation

showAccentBorder.description: Draw the 1pt accent ribbon on the window's bottom edge. Off unless authored. Shells that own their footer band (card, provisioning, migration, setup-assistant) never draw it.

sideInterval.description: Side message rotation interval in seconds

sideMessage.description: Messages that rotate under the title every sideInterval seconds: Preset 1's default shell and Preset 2. A single string is a one-item list. Presets 5 and 7 take a step's own sideMessages.

size.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect. Each shell has one size (plain 800x600, sidebar 920x620, card/rail 820x560, toast 550x110). Use width/height to change the window and 'density' to change type size.

skipPortal.description: Skip portal phase entirely (Preset5) - go directly from intro to outro

supportText.description: Optional support contact text in footer

triggerFile.description: Custom trigger file path (overrides dev/prod defaults)

contentAnchor.description: Default vertical content stance for every step (a step may override). P5/P6/P7 default to 'top'; 'center' restores the centred look across the flow.

contentAlign.description: Default horizontal content stance for every step (steps may override). Presets 5-7 default to 'leading' (full-width measure); 'center' uses the centred 480pt column. On plain-simple, 'leading' moves the media step onto the media rail.

phaseBackground.description: Backdrop for all phases: 'plain' (default), 'gradient' (soft wash, tinted by phaseBackgroundPalette), 'splash' (dark splash ground; pair with appearance 'dark'), 'ethereal', 'vivid' or 'subtle' (procedural layers), or 'banded' (setup-assistant journey screen only: an accent band behind the title; plain elsewhere).

phaseBackgroundSource.description: Managed-preference override for the backdrop. Defaults to domain au.csiro.dialog.setup, key PhaseBackground; palette keys are '<key>Palette' / '<key>PaletteDark' in the same domain.

phaseBackgroundPalette.description: Brand palette (hex) tinting the backdrop — always composited at atmosphere strength, never full bleed

phaseBackgroundPaletteDark.description: Optional dark-scheme palette (defaults to the light palette over the dark base)

successColor.description: Hex color for the success bars and ticks (the CI-color unification). Absent: the design green.

glow.description: How much accent glow the flow draws (the halo round an active card, the plate behind its icon, the light under a ceremony mark): 'full' (default), 'soft', 'subtle' or 'none'. Every preset.

itemSortOrder.description: Order of the item list in Preset 1. 'completedFirst' (default): done, then installing, then waiting. 'activeFirst': installing, then waiting, then done. 'guiIndex': config order. The last two scroll to keep the installing item in view.

stepCounterPlacement.description: Where the card chrome states the step count. 'header' (default), 'footer' (beside the brand mark; the counter moves, it is not duplicated), 'dots' (the setup-assistant dot rail) or 'none'. Unknown values fall back to 'header'.

chrome.description: Which shell renders the flow: 'plain' (default), 'plain-simple', 'plain-centered', 'plain-branded' (Preset 1), 'sidebar', 'card', 'rail', or the Preset 5 shells 'provisioning', 'migration', 'setup-assistant' and 'splash'. Absent or unsupported, the preset's default is used; 'fixture' resolves to it with an advisory.

migrationBodies.description: Draw this flow's steps with the migration bodies (receipt, media split, task list). Implied by chrome 'migration'; set it on Preset 6, plain-branded or plain-simple. Blocks the bodies do not use are dropped.

buttonShape.description: Button shape for the whole flow: 'pill' (capsule) or 'rounded' (rounded rectangle). Absent leaves the current render alone. Text-only affordances (Back, Later, Reveal in Finder) carry no shape.

ShowWhen.description: Show this step (or run this cadence entry) only when a recorded pick matches, e.g. {"key": "team", "anyOf": ["engineering"]}. anyOf needs at least one listed value (unanswered hides); noneOf needs none (unanswered passes). Hidden steps are skipped.

key.description: A recorded value: the splash environmentKey, an option key, a form field id, a key set by select:, or an outcome ('items.done', 'items.failed', '<cadenceStepId>.done', '<cadenceStepId>.failed'). Read by Preset 5 and 6 steps.

anyOf.description: Show when any picked value is listed.

noneOf.description: Hide when any picked value is listed.

CadenceAttribute.description: Condition that gates cadence advancement. 'native' sources are evaluated by swiftDialog; 'ipc' advances via the cadence: command (e.g. cadence:satisfy:<id>).

source.description: 'native' = swiftDialog evaluates the attribute | 'ipc' = advanced externally by the cadence: command

path.description: file existence / app-by-path / plist / defaults / json file path

evaluation.description: How to compare the read value against expectedValue (default 'exists'). 'contains' is a case-folded substring match for a string value and exact membership for an array value; other scalars use their string form. No expectedValue means false.

useUserDefaults.description: For 'defaults' reads, use UserDefaults instead of file polling

scope.description: type:'managedpref' — device scope (/Library/Managed Preferences/<domain>.plist) or user scope

CadenceEntry.description: One gated message in a cadence sequence. The sequence advances to the next entry when this entry's attribute is satisfied.

id.description: Stable id — used for cadence:satisfy:<id> and SwiftUI identity

message.description: Claim shown while this entry is active

minDwell.description: Minimum seconds to show even if already satisfied (anti-flash)

timeout.description: Force-advance after N seconds if the attribute is never satisfied

sfSymbol.description: Per-entry SF Symbol (overrides the step hero while active)

iconColor.description: Hex colour for the SF Symbol

label.description: Short tile name (metaphor), e.g. Ground power

subtitle.description: tiles: the real function line under the metaphor name, e.g. Support tools 3.0.3

timeEstimate.description: Seconds; the tiles sidecar countdown checks down per card

size.description: Human size (38 MB) — feeds the Items · MB sidecar line

stay.description: Once this entry is satisfied the cadence holds here and the step does not auto-advance. Intended for the last entry. Without stayMaxHold only the orchestrator closing the dialog exits it.

stayMaxHold.description: Seconds after which Continue becomes live regardless of continueWhileRunning while stay still holds the cadence; the escape from a stay dead end.

onTimeout.description: What this entry's timeout means: 'pass' (default; advance quietly), 'fail' (advance, the card says Didn't finish) or 'halt' (stop the cadence; Continue is revealed).

ManagedValueRef.description: Reference to a value in a managed preference by domain and key, read from /Library/Managed Preferences/<domain>.plist.

key.description: Key within that domain (light value for colours)

AdvisoryFinding.description: One row of an `advisory` block: what is wrong, what it costs, what to do, how long it takes. The key list is closed because the Swift struct has no aliases.

icon.description: An .app bundle, an image path, or an SF Symbol name. Absent means the row leads with its state glyph alone

state.description: The glyph, and the only colour on the row

title.description: Named in the user's terms ('macOS is three versions behind'), not as a policy label.

detail.description: Why it matters, in one sentence

duration.description: What it will cost the user: '~25 min · 1 restart'

AppConfigSource.description: MDM AppConfig source for dynamic branding overrides. Maps MDM managed preference keys to existing InspectConfig branding fields.

allowedBrandsKey.description: MDM key for array of allowed brand IDs (brand picker filtering)

button1TextKey.description: MDM key for primary button text

button2TextKey.description: MDM key for secondary button text

domain.description: Preference domain (e.g., 'com.company.branding'). Defaults to app bundle identifier.

introButtonTextKey.description: MDM key for intro continue button text

introTitleKey.description: MDM key for intro screen title

outroButtonTextKey.description: MDM key for outro close button text

outroTitleKey.description: MDM key for outro screen title

supportURLKey.description: MDM key for support URL override

BentoCellConfig.description: Configuration for a bento grid cell

detailOverlay.description: Optional detail overlay shown when cell is clicked

gradientPalette.description: Array of hex colors for gradient palette

iconColor.description: Hex color for SF Symbol (overrides accentColor)

rows.description: The tile's middle zone: each row owns its own action button, with hairlines between. Tile height follows the row count.

sfSymbol.description: SF Symbol name for icon content type

surface.description: Which tinted surface this cell sits on. Omitted, surfaces rotate through accent/cool/warm/neutral; success/warning/info are authorable only. The surface also fixes the cell's text colour. An explicit backgroundColor/textColor still wins.

detailPresentation.description: How the cell's detailOverlay opens: 'sheet', 'popover' (anchored to the cell) or 'inline' (the cell expands in place over a dimmed grid). Omitted, the grid's inline-expansion setting decides, else the sheet. A cell without a detailOverlay always opens the sheet.

badge.description: Pill shown beside the cell title (e.g. "Beta"). Distinct from `label`, which renders small-caps above the title.

meta.description: Trailing fine print on a supporting cell (e.g. "1.4 GB", "iOS · Android").

actionLabel.description: Cell-level action button label. With `action`/`url`/`requestId`, the same routing InstallItem rows use.

BrandConfig.description: Brand option for multi-brand onboarding picker

logoConfigPath.description: Active logo path for footer/sidebar (overrides logoConfig.imagePath)

BrandPalette.description: Brand color palette with semantic color tokens and logo presets. Use $tokenName syntax to reference tokens (e.g., '$primary').

logos.description: Logo presets (name -> path or SF Symbol string)

notice.description: Temporary-notice states, e.g. a removed item (default: #724913 light / #e0b378 dark)

CardPanelPair.description: One label/value row of a CardPanel facts card. The key list is closed because the Swift struct has no aliases.

CardPanel.description: Right-hand panel of a card-chrome step. 'image' or 'video' gives a screenshot frame, 'paragraphs' a reassurance card, otherwise 'stat'/'pairs' a facts card.

video.description: Looping clip in the screenshot frame (overrides image)

layout.description: 'max': media-hero step (rail) — player fills the column

CardScreen.description: One of several screens paged inside a single flow step (card chrome only). The header's eyebrow and 'Step n of N' counter stay put; each screen brings its own title, blocks and card panel; the action bar carries the pager.

title.description: Screen heading for this sub-step; absent falls back to the step's own title

continueButtonText.description: The primary button names the outcome of this screen.

excellent.description: Score from which the range is excellent, as a fraction (0.9 = 90%)

good.description: Score from which the range is good, as a fraction (0.7 = 70%)

warning.description: Score from which the range is warning, as a fraction (0.5 = 50%)

ComparisonCheck.description: One row of a multi-row 'comparison-table' block. The key list is closed because the Swift struct has no aliases.

checksPassed.description: Format for 'X of Y checks passed' (use {passed}, {total})

label.description: Human-readable label override; auto-generated from duration if nil

DeferralConfig.description: User-initiated deferral menu, shared across presets. Deferring writes the result file and exits with code 10.

enabled.description: Show the defer menu (also enabled by the IGNITECLI_DEFER_ENABLED=true environment variable).

options.description: Deferral duration options. Falls back to the IGNITECLI_DEFER_OPTIONS environment variable.

detailMedia.description: Image/GIF/video path for right-side media panel in inline detail view

enabled.description: Enable overlay. A present overlay IS the opt-in; set false to keep it and hide it. Every seat reads it this way.

icon.description: SF Symbol or image path for header

wide.description: Use wider overlay dimensions (900-1100 instead of default 720-880)

icon.description: Optional SF Symbol icon for column header

detail.description: A qualifier under the feature name — 'bundled', 'v16.9 or later', 'superseded by Company VPN'.

values.description: Boolean values for each column (true = checkmark, false = X)

GridItemConfig.description: Grid item for picker screens (wallpaper, theme selection, etc.)

value.description: Value to store when selected (defaults to id)

StatCell.description: One stat tile of a 'stat-row' block: a big figure over a caption. Values come from the config or from measured tokens (e.g. {cadenceCount}).

label.description: The caption below the figure (e.g. 'Apps to install').

state.description: Tints this tile and its figure through the palette: 'ok', 'warning', 'error' or 'info' (success/pass, warn and fail/failed are accepted too). Absent, the tile is neutral.

action.description: Button action. 'url' opens a URL (a custom scheme is a deeplink the target app may reject; use 'app' to merely launch it). 'app' launches the application named in 'url' by bundle identifier or bundle path and surfaces its window. 'minimize' miniaturizes the window instead of closing or advancing.

actual.description: Display value for status-badge (shown instead of state text while state controls icon/color) or actual value for comparison-table

autoAdvanceDelay.description: Seconds a carousel holds each slide before advancing (default 3.0); read only when `autoAdvance` is true. Unrelated to the root `autoAdvanceDelay`, which times Preset 6's step advance.

bentoColumns.description: Number of columns in bento grid. 2 on every surface that draws one.

bentoGap.description: Gap between cells in points for bento grid

bentoLayout.description: Bento arrangement for this block: 'hero' (one hero cell over a supporting row) or 'summary' (one hero cell beside a stacked column), the same values as the step-level key. 'grid', absent or any other value renders the grid layout. 'split' is a step-level concept and is not accepted here.

bentoRowHeight.description: Base row height in points for bento grid

bentoTintColor.description: Base hex color for auto-tinting bento cells

buttonStyle.description: Button visual style. 'prominent' is an alias of 'borderedProminent'; 'link' renders as a link. An unrecognised value falls back to 'bordered'.

mediaLayout.description: How media occupies the payload band: 'inline' (default, one block in the stack), 'fill' (the whole band, caption moved to the action bar) or 'split' (a fixed media box beside the step's other content).

mediaItems.description: media-carousel: the media to page through. Each item is typed at render, so images, GIFs, direct video files and YouTube/Vimeo embeds all work.

mediaFit.description: media-carousel: how an image fills its box. 'fit' (default) shows the whole image; 'fill' crops to fill.

cardIcon.description: SF Symbol icon for card header

checklist.description: Marker lines for 'checklist' blocks: numbered chips on intros, check/info/warn marks on outros. Number markers count only numbered lines.

marker.description: Marker style; 'number' uses the 1-based position among numbered lines

hint.description: Secondary line under 'text' — where to look, what to tick. Keeps 'text' an instruction instead of a sentence

paths.description: Per-line watch: file paths monitored for this line. The step-level 'paths'/'plistKey' still apply. A line with no 'paths' is unwatched: it renders its authored 'marker' and makes no claim about verification.

plistKey.description: Per-line watch: plist key to check, evaluated the same way as the step-level watch

expectedValue.description: Per-line watch: expected value for the evaluation

evaluation.description: Per-line watch: how to compare the read plist value against expectedValue (default 'exists')

context.description: Trailing muted label saying where this step lives ('General', 'Encryption'). 'hint' renders beneath the line and says what to do.

checks.description: Rows of a multi-row 'comparison-table' block. Each row: 'check', 'required', 'found' (all required), plus optional 'pass', 'expanded', 'note', 'actionLabel', 'actionURL'. A block-level expected/actual pair is folded into a one-row 'checks' array at decode.

text.description: Alias for `content`, folded into it at decode with an advisory. `content` is the canonical spelling.

title.description: On a callout (warning | info | success), promotes it to a card: icon tile, this string as the heading, `content` as the body. `style: "chip"` wins over it.

continueAtNow.description: slot-picker: primary button label when the handle sits at 'now' (e.g. 'Install now')

continueFormat.description: slot-picker: primary button label template with a {time} placeholder (e.g. 'Schedule for {time}')

deadline.description: slot-picker: the marked deadline tick, ISO-8601 with offset

deadlineNote.description: slot-picker: text explaining what happens at/after the deadline

defaultAt.description: slot-picker: where the handle opens — ISO-8601, or 'now' / 'deadline'

discreteSteps.description: Array of discrete step values with labels for slider. When defined, slider snaps to these values instead of continuous range.

dock.description: The grouped dock-picker spelling on a block, folded onto the flat dock* keys at decode. Same container as the step level.

dockApplyMode.description: Dock-picker: 'additive' (default) appends the chosen apps to the existing Dock, 'replace' rebuilds the Dock from them. swiftDialog does not change the Dock; it emits dock:<key>:<applyMode>:<paths> on the interaction log for a script to apply.

dockConfirmButton.description: Dock-picker: confirm button text (nil = instant select)

dockDecline.description: Dock-picker: the explicit 'change nothing' card. Omit for no decline option.

dockFlavors.description: Dock-picker (flavors mode): the preset docks to choose from

dockItems.description: Dock-picker (build mode): the candidate apps to choose/order

dockLayout.description: Dock-picker measure. 'narrow' selects the 560pt measure instead of the picker's default.

dockMode.description: Dock-picker mode: 'flavors' (pick one preset dock, default) or 'build' (choose/order apps)

dockPreferenceKey.description: Dock-picker: preferences-plist key for osquery/MDM output

dockSelectionKey.description: Dock-picker: selection storage/emit key (falls back to the block id). Emitted as dock:<key>:<ordered,paths>

facts.description: slot-picker: label/value fact rows (e.g. Duration, Your work)

limit.description: drop-zone with multiple: the most files it keeps; the first ones dropped stay.

multiple.description: drop-zone: collect several dropped files (one path per line in the value) rather than replace one.

fileType.description: File-select filter (textfieldMode 'file'): space-separated tokens 'folder', 'image', 'movie'/'video', 'audio', or filename extensions (classic --textfield grammar).

findings.description: Rows of an 'advisory' block. Each row: 'title' (required), plus optional 'icon', 'state' ('error' | 'warning' | 'success'), 'detail', 'deadline', 'duration'.

granularityMinutes.description: slot-picker: minutes the handle snaps to

gridSelectionMode.description: grid-picker: how many cells may be selected (default 'single')

gridSelectionKey.description: grid-picker: the userValues key the selection is stored and emitted under (default 'grid'). There is no block-level gridPreferenceKey; the preferences writer walks steps.

helpText.description: Help text displayed in info popover

id.description: Unique identifier for storing user input

imageFit.description: image-carousel only: how each slide fills its frame. 'fill' (default) crops to the frame; 'fit' shows the whole picture. Note the media-carousel's 'mediaFit' defaults to 'fit'.

imageHeight.description: Height in points. image-carousel: each slide's height (default 300). image: an image file is sized by this height when authored, else by imageWidth; the device mark ('computer') likewise; a GIF is capped at it instead of 0.75 x imageWidth; an SF Symbol's frame is this tall (default 200) with the glyph half of it.

imageWidth.description: Maximum width of the picture in points (default 400) for an image file, a GIF (height then capped at 0.75 x this) and each image-carousel slide. The device mark ('computer') defaults to 128. An SF Symbol ignores this key and is sized by imageHeight; an authored imageHeight wins over this on an image file.

initialPath.description: Directory the file-select panel starts in (textfieldMode: 'file'; default: user home)

handoffs.description: handoff-list entries. Entries with a `detail` sentence render as cards, entries without as rows. Rows naming an itemId take live install status.

bundleRows.description: bundle-list: the catalogue's bundle rows with status and action already resolved from live detection.

detailRows.description: bundle-detail (tier 3 software port): one bundle's apps as four resolved row kinds — present, installing, missing, failed.

bundleCommand.description: bundle-detail: the command that will run, shown verbatim in a code frame under the caption 'Runs on your Mac'.

bundleCommandNote.description: bundle-detail: the line under the command ("No admin password needed · the agent has the rights").

installLayout.description: install-list: which installation design to draw: 'rows' (default, the vertical list), 'cards' or 'manifest'.

numbered.description: For bullets: use numbered circle icons (1.circle.fill, etc.) instead of a single icon

option.description: The grouped option-picker spelling on a block, folded onto the flat option* keys at decode. Same container as the step level.

optionCards.description: Option-picker: the selectable cards (type 'option-picker'). 'options' is the plain dropdown/radio string list.

optionConfirmButton.description: Option-picker: confirm button text (nil = instant select)

optionKey.description: Option-picker: selection storage/emit key (falls back to the block id). Emitted as select:<key>:<value>

optionLayout.description: Option-picker layout (default: 'rows'). 'rows' is the decision arrangement: one full-width row per option, so cost lines are not truncated

optionMultiSelect.description: Option-picker: allow multiple selections (default false). 'wallpaperMultiSelect' is a count and means something different.

optionPreferenceKey.description: Option-picker: preferences-plist key for osquery/MDM output

time.description: Clock time, elapsed or estimate — e.g. '09:12', 'now · 62%', '~25 min'

detail.description: Sentence shown under the label in the vertical variant

state.description: Authored state. Absent derives it from currentPhase. Failure is a state of a real phase — never add a phase called 'Error'.

chunkSize.description: Coarse share of the track width (default 'regular'), so a long install and a short check stop looking equally long. Absent on every phase means equal segments.

portalConfig.description: Per-block portal configuration overriding the global portalConfig, including openExternalLinksInBrowser. Flat portal* keys on the block still take precedence.

portalHeight.description: Height of embedded portal view in points

portalURL.description: Override portal URL for this block (uses global portalConfig if nil)

quickPicks.description: slot-picker: named jump points on the strip (e.g. 'Now', 'Last slot')

regexError.description: Error message when regex validation fails

requestId.description: Abstract identifier for script callback (for action: request)

required.description: Whether this input is required for step completion

secondaryAtLater.description: slot-picker: secondary button label when the handle sits before the deadline (e.g. 'Install now instead'); hidden when the handle is at 'now'

sectionLabel.description: Small-caps heading above an 'advisory' block's rows, e.g. '2 things to fix', 'What changed'

shell.description: Shell command to execute (for action: shell)

specimen.description: Frames this block with a hairline and a monospaced chip carrying this exact string, for a reference catalogue. Never translated. Absent, the block renders unframed. Ignored on a card step for 'bullets', 'checklist', 'warning' and 'text', which render through the card's compact rows.

specimenNote.description: One line of when-to-use shown beneath a specimen frame. Prose, and translatable through the per-block sidecar mapping. Ignored unless 'specimen' is set.

stats.description: The tiles of a 'stat-row' block, left to right. A stat-row without stats draws a debug hint instead of a row.

style.description: Display style, per block type. dropdown: 'searchable', 'multiselect' (CSV value) or 'option-rows'. info/warning/success: 'chip' or 'panel'. label-value: 'default', 'success' or 'table'. compliance-detail button: 'link' (default), 'bordered' or 'prominent'. feature-table: 'dark'. phase-tracker: 'stepper' (default). progress-bar: 'indeterminate' (default until progress is non-zero). stat-row: 'card'. bullets: 'rows'.

textfieldMode.description: Textfield mode: 'date' (emits yyyy-MM-dd), 'file' (path plus open panel), 'editor' (multi-line) or 'confirm' (re-enter to match). Omit for a plain field. Honoured by Preset 6; Preset 5 ignores it.

type.description: Content block type. 'compliance-summary' and 'findings-list' render live from plistSources (preset5 and preset6). 'option-picker' and 'dock-picker' emit the choice over IPC (select:/dock:) for an orchestrator to apply.

videoLoop.description: Seamless ambient loop with hidden controls (AVPlayerLooper) — for background/walkthrough clips

note.description: Right-hand annotation on a form-section heading — 'optional', 'opens every link'. The one fact a reader wants about a group before reading its fields.

optionIcons.description: Per-option leading icon, parallel to 'options': 'SF=name', a bare SF Symbol name, or an image path (absolute, or relative to iconBasePath). When any option has one, every row reserves the slot.

optionDetails.description: Per-option second line, parallel to 'options' (index i describes options[i]); used by dropdown blocks with style 'option-rows'. A shorter array leaves later options without a subline.

footnote.description: Small caption under an 'advisory' block's findings (e.g. 'Checked 6 Aug at 09:12 · next check in 4 hours'); absent, the block draws no caption.

follow.description: type 'prose' only: keep the newest line in view as content arrives over IPC (update_guidance ...:line= adds a line, :append= adds text as written, :content= replaces; stream=end closes the stream). Values carry \n for a newline and \\ for a backslash; nothing else is interpreted.

showWhen.description: Show this block only when a recorded value matches, with the same rule as a step's showWhen, on every surface that draws blocks. E.g. {"key": "items.done", "anyOf": ["zoom"]} on a summary screen.

visible.description: Show or hide this block. Set it from a plistMonitor (targetProperty 'visible') or an update_guidance command to reveal a block once a condition holds. A hidden block occupies no space.

wallpaper.description: The grouped wallpaper spelling on a block, folded onto the flat wallpaper* keys at decode. Same container as the step level.

wallpaperCategories.description: Categories of wallpapers to choose from

wallpaperColumns.description: Number of columns per row for wallpaper picker

wallpaperImageFit.description: Image scaling mode for wallpaper picker

wallpaperMultiSelect.description: Number of monitors for multi-select (nil/0 = single select)

wallpaperPreferenceKey.description: Wallpaper picker: preferences-plist key for osquery/MDM output. Accepted at block level but not read there; the step-level key is applied.

wallpaperShowPath.description: Show file path below wallpaper selection

windowHours.description: slot-picker: length of the strip in hours, from 'now'

requiredOptions.description: select-list/select-grid: options that cannot be unchecked (58d's locked row). Always counted as selected.

optionActions.description: action-rows: per-row action button label, parallel to options; empty = no button.

optionURLs.description: action-rows: URL each row's action opens (x-apple.systempreferences links included).

enabled.description: Show help button. A present helpButton IS the opt-in; set false to keep the config and hide it. Every preset reads it this way.

icon.description: SF Symbol icon (default 'questionmark.circle'). On Preset 5 it is a 15pt glyph in the brand colour, in a card's header row beside the step counter or in the top corner on a screen with no card header.

position.description: Where the help glyph sits in the header row: any value containing 'Left' seats it top-left, everything else top-right. Bottom and sidebar spellings are accepted and resolve to the top seats.

InstallItem.description: One row: an install-list item, a detail-rows row, or a bento tile row (BentoCellConfig.rows). Fields outside a given block's set are ignored by it.

icon.description: Icon path or SF Symbol. Usually omitted: the icon then comes from an `app` requirement's bundle id, the first existing `paths` entry, or the default. A missing app's icon is picked up once it installs.

itemId.description: Links to items[] entry for dynamic status updates

status.description: How an install RUN is going. Not whether the thing is already present — that is `state`.

state.description: Whether the thing is already here, in the OptionCard.state vocabulary. Distinct from `status`, which reports a run in progress.

badge.description: A short trailing chip stating a fact about the download ("1.2 GB"). Never a status.

claim.description: install-list 'cards'/'manifest' layouts: one line of why this app is here. Drawn on a 300pt measure.

size.description: install-list 'cards'/'manifest' layouts: download size as a fact ("1.2 GB"). Falls back to `badge`.

identifier.description: install-list 'cards'/'manifest' layouts: bundle identifier. Clipped from the left when it overflows.

stateLabel.description: The word in the right column — Queued, Downloaded, Installed, Verified, Removed, Skipped, Failed. Absent means derived from `status`.

detail.description: Multi-line description paragraph shown below the title row (detail-rows)

subtitleSymbol.description: SF Symbol shown after the subtitle (e.g. "safari" beside "Website")

actionLabel.description: Trailing action button label (e.g. "Install", "Open", "Download for macOS"); absent means no button

failureNote.description: Shown under a failed row, with the retry scoped to that item.

retryLabel.description: Label for the per-item retry affordance

IntroStep.description: A step in the multi-step wizard. Properties vary by stepType; a step without stepType is a standard step.

windowPosition.description: Reposition the live window when this item appears: left/right/center/topleft/etc., as the per-step windowPosition.

windowPositionOffset.description: Optional edge offset in points for windowPosition

logAliases.description: Extra names this row answers to in log text, for lines that name the artefact (an installer filename) rather than the item. Distinct from `paths`, which prove installation on disk.

claim.description: A note about what is happening to this item: present participle, one clause, under 40 characters ('Handing over the keys'). Distinct from `subtitle`, which says what the thing is.

size.description: Download size as a human string ("86 MB", "1.1 GB"). Authored, because nothing here can measure it.

actionButtonText.description: Custom button text for this step's action

banner.description: Banner image path for card-style presets

blocking.description: Mark item as blocking further progress

continueButtonText.description: Custom button text after step completes

dockCandidate.description: Offer this item in the outro dock picker. Opt-in subset: when any item sets it, only flagged items are offered; when none do, every completed item is

evaluation.description: Comparison for plist validation. 'contains' is a case-folded substring match for a string value and exact membership for an array value; other scalars use their string form. No expectedValue means false.

finalButtonText.description: Custom button text when step is complete

gradientColors.description: Custom gradient colors for this card

guidanceContent.description: Rich content blocks for the step

icon.description: Icon path or SF Symbol. Usually omitted: the icon then comes from an `app` requirement's bundle id, the first existing `paths` entry, or the default. A missing app's icon is picked up once it installs.

jsonMonitors.description: JSON monitors that auto-update guidance components

keyPointsText.description: Custom paragraph text for Key Points section

paths.description: File paths to monitor for validation

plistMonitors.description: Plist monitors that auto-update guidance components

plistRecheckInterval.description: Interval in seconds to recheck plist (0 = once)

processingDuration.description: Duration in seconds for processing steps

processingMode.description: Processing mode: simple auto-completes, progressive waits for triggers

required.description: Item presets (1-3): whether the primary button waits for this item (default true). An optional item may stay pending or fail without holding the button. The move to the summary screen still waits for every item.

showBundleInfo.description: Display bundle info when app is installed

status.description: Status icon for list items (supports dynamic updates)

stepType.description: The step's renderer. 'intro'/'outro' name a role and belong in `phase`; 'info'/'confirmation'/'completion' name a row shape and belong in a ListItem's `kind`; all five are accepted for compatibility.

phase.description: The step's role in the flow, independent of its renderer: 'intro', 'main' (default) or 'outro'. Preset 6 reads the bookends, rail contents and sidebar navigability from it. An 'intro'/'outro' authored in `stepType` still resolves here.

subtitle.description: Per-item description shown under the item name: inline in presets 1, 3 and 5; under the step heading in preset 6; in the info popover on the card's 'i' badge in preset 2.

successMessage.description: Message shown when step completes successfully

useUserDefaults.description: Use UserDefaults for instant notification-based monitoring

waitForExternalTrigger.description: Never auto-complete - always wait for success:/failure: command

waitLargeOverrideTime.description: Show large override button after X seconds

waitSmallOverrideTime.description: Show small override link after X seconds

waitWarningTime.description: Show warning after X seconds waiting

openURL.description: What 'Open' does for this app in a software step. Omitted, the app is launched (from its app-requirement bundle id, else its first path). Set to a URL and that is opened instead. A bare custom scheme is a deeplink the app may refuse, so prefer omitting for a plain open.

managedPrefDomain.description: Preset 3: managed-preference payload domain. The item completes when /Library/Managed Preferences/<domain>.plist exists. Admin details show the domain.

managedPrefKey.description: Key within managedPrefDomain (default check: exists; expectedValue/evaluation refine)

requirements.description: Requirement-based completion. Each requirement is one logical fact with any-of alternative evidence; the item completes per `satisfy` over the group. When present, the paths/plistKey detection ladder is ignored for this item.

type.description: path: any of `paths` exists · app: `bundleId` resolves through LaunchServices · receipt: <receiptsBasePath>/<pkgId>.plist|.bom exists · plist: domain/path plus key evaluated.

negate.description: Invert satisfaction (e.g. an agent must not be present).

paths.description: path type: alternative locations, any existing satisfies

bundleId.description: app type: bundle identifier (e.g. com.figma.Desktop), resolved via LaunchServices

domain.description: plist type: UserDefaults suite (composed read incl. managed preferences)

path.description: plist type: absolute plist file (alternative to domain)

evaluation.description: plist type: comparison against expectedValue (default 'equals' with expectedValue, 'exists' without). 'contains' is a case-folded substring match for a string value and exact membership for an array value; other scalars use their string form. No expectedValue means false.

satisfy.description: How the card completes over its requirements: all (default) or any (first satisfied requirement wins)

cardPanel.description: Right-hand panel of a card-chrome step: 'caption', 'stat', 'pairs' (label/value rows), 'image', 'video' (looping clip, overrides image), 'imageTitle', 'paragraphs', 'layout' ('max' = media fills the column). Media gives a screenshot frame, 'paragraphs' a reassurance card, otherwise a facts card.

continueAction.description: Action on continue: 'next', 'skip', 'portal', 'minimize' (miniaturize the window instead of advancing), or a custom script.

footerNote.description: Outro footer note (Markdown), rendered in place of the step dots

group.description: Consecutive steps sharing a group render under one heading in the rail. Absent = ungrouped.

version.description: Version per row ('142.0') — rows state version · size. Authored, like size.

timeEstimate.description: Rough install time in seconds. The install sidecar's Time-left sums these over unfinished rows (active row scaled by remaining fraction). An estimate only.

guidanceBlockIndex.description: Index of guidance component to update (0-based)

key.description: JSON key path to monitor (supports dot notation)

severity.description: Severity shown in the bento detail sheet. Omitted, it is derived from the check result (passing = healthy, failing = failure). 'warning' marks a failing check as advisory. Config-only; not read from the plist.

explanation.description: Why this check matters, shown in the detail sheet; Markdown supported. A matching key in the compliance plist overrides this default.

remediation.description: Remediation steps shown in the detail sheet when severity is not 'healthy'; Markdown supported. A matching key in the compliance plist overrides this default.

actionButtonText.description: Label for the optional remediation button (e.g. 'Open Software Update'), rendered only when severity is not 'healthy' and actionURL is set. A matching key in the compliance plist overrides this default.

actionURL.description: URL the action button opens (e.g. 'x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.Software-Update-Settings.extension'). A matching key in the compliance plist overrides this default.

expected.description: Value the baseline requires, e.g. 'expire_after >= 90', shown beside the value found. A matching key in the compliance plist overrides this default; 'found' and 'lastPassed' are read from the plist only.

reference.description: Baseline reference for this check, e.g. 'CIS 3.4', rendered as monospaced meta beside the plist key. A matching key in the compliance plist overrides this default.

LocalizationConfig.description: Language sidecar files for translating intro step text. Files are flat JSON with keys like '{stepId}.title', '{stepId}.content.0.content'.

defaultLanguage.description: 'auto' = system locale, 'de' = fixed. A language code also finds a 'languages' key spelled as a display name ('de' -> 'Deutsch'). null = no default

languages.description: Language code or name -> file path map (e.g., { "de": "lang/de.json" }). A relative path resolves against iconBasePath when set, else the config file's directory.

LogMonitorConfig.description: Configuration for monitoring log files and extracting status text via regex patterns

format.description: 'json' parses each line as a JSON object (statusKey/itemKey) instead of matching 'pattern'. Absent: line/regex matching.

statusKey.description: format json: the key holding the status.

itemKey.description: format json: the key naming the item the status applies to.

autoMatch.description: Auto-match status to items by displayName

addRows.description: Log presets (munki, installomator, jamf, ...): an item the log names that no row matches gets a row of its own, named as the log names it and never counted toward completion. The fleet preset always adds rows.

itemIds.description: Target item IDs for log monitor matches

predicate.description: Filter: only process lines containing this string

preset.description: Named preset with predefined patterns. 'fleet' reads the Setup Experience progress file instead of a log: set path to setup_experience_progress.json, plus optional eventsPath and serverURL. Rows match by id (sw-<software_title_id>, bootstrap, profile-<name>, script) or display name.

startFromEnd.description: Start reading from end of file

eventsPath.description: fleet preset: orbit's software_install_events.jsonl (its rotated .1 is read too). Absent: rows show states only, no download progress.

serverURL.description: fleet preset: the Fleet server for icons. Absent: FleetURL from the fleetd managed profile, else ORBIT_FLEET_URL from orbit's launch daemon.

imagePathDark.description: Dark mode variant (falls back to imagePath if nil)

introVerticalOffset.description: Vertical nudge for intro phase (falls back to verticalOffset)

maxHeight.description: Height of the brand mark in points. Unset, each shell uses its own default (18 to 28 in footers and rails; the corner mark 28 at the bottom or 40 at the top).

maxWidth.description: Width cap in points, honoured when authored (Preset 1 and the plain shells box the mark to it). Unauthored means height-only sizing. The corner mark takes no width cap.

opacity.description: Logo opacity (default: 0.6 for bottom, 1.0 for top)

outroVerticalOffset.description: Vertical nudge for outro/summary phase (falls back to verticalOffset)

padding.description: Corner mark's distance from the window edges, in points. At the top it sets both axes (defaults 12 horizontal, 16 vertical). At the bottom it sets only the vertical distance (default: the footer's padding, else 20); the horizontal distance is fixed at 20.

position.description: Where the brand mark sits: 'footer' (default; the shell's closing band), 'header' (opposite the title) or 'none'. Legacy corner values are accepted: anything containing 'bottom' means 'footer', anything containing 'top' means 'header'.

logoClearSpace.description: Clear-space margin around the trimmed logo mark, as a fraction of height. 0 = tight (fleet), ~0.12 = spaced (a wide wordmark).

verticalOffset.description: Vertical nudge in points: negative=up, positive=down

lockup.description: Which brands the footer carries. 'vendor' (default): the vendor mark alone. 'both': the customer brand (mark and name from the selected brands[] entry), a divider, 'Managed with', then the vendor mark on one baseline. Provisioning shell only.

MediaItemConfig.description: Media item for carousel (images, GIFs, YouTube, Vimeo, etc.)

guidanceBlockIndex.description: Index of guidance component to update (0-based)

key.description: Plist key to monitor (supports dot notation)

categoryIcons.description: Map of category name to icon string, e.g. 'OS Security': 'sf=shield.fill,colour1=#007AFF'.

healthyLabel.description: Label for a passing check (default 'Healthy'), shown in bento subtitles, compliance-summary cards, findings-list rows and the plist-bound popover.

attentionLabel.description: User-facing label for a failing check. Default: 'Needs Attention'.

rescanCommand.description: Command that re-runs the checks. When set, the detail sheet's button reads 'Re-run checks'; unset, it reads 'Refresh' and re-reads the plist. Either way a 'rescan:requested' line is written to the interaction log.

type.description: A label for the source. Every type is processed the same way: keyMappings decide which keys are read when present, otherwise every non-metadata key is.

detail.description: Presence of this promotes the entry from a row to a card

target.description: What the row launches, printed beside it ('figma://'). This IS the diagnosability — a row that fails tells you what it tried

itemId.description: Gate the row on this item's detected state — a scheme for something not yet installed is shown with the reason, never silently disabled

BundleRowPayload.description: bundle-list row: a bundle as an icon strip plus its counted state and action, resolved from live detection.

id.description: Also the itemId a `request` action and the detail navigation both name

size.description: Authored download size text ("6.8 GB") — never computed

icons.description: One entry per member app, in bundle order — the icon strip

installedCount.description: Count from live detection, never authored. Used only when `icons` is absent or empty; when both are present, `icons` wins.

hasDetail.description: Whether a bundle-detail step exists for this bundle; resolved, so the row never advertises a screen that was not authored.

BundleMemberIcon.description: One member app's icon inside a BundleRowPayload's strip — the AppIconView inputs plus its resolved status.

DetailRowPayload.description: bundle-detail row: one bundle's app as one of four row kinds (present, installing, missing, failed), resolved from live detection.

itemId.description: Links to the step's items[] entry this row resolved from

status.description: StepStatus raw value, resolved by the arm

detail.description: Version/build text read off the installed bundle — present only when the app is actually there

PortalConfig.description: Self-service portal configuration; pages load without sign-in or custom request headers. URL can be provided via portalURL or portalURLFile.

button1Text.description: Portal-specific primary button text (overrides global button1text)

button2Text.description: Portal-specific secondary button text (overrides global button2text)

fallbackMessage.description: Message shown when portal is unavailable

openExternalLinksInBrowser.description: Open links to non-portal hosts in the default browser instead of loading inside the webview

portalURL.description: Base URL of the self-service portal (fallback if portalURLFile not found)

portalURLFile.description: Path to file containing portal URL. Read at launch, overrides portalURL. Useful for dynamic device-specific URLs set by external scripts.

selfServiceOnly.description: Skip outro screens, go directly to exit after portal

supportContact.description: Contact info shown when portal is offline (e.g., phone, email, Slack channel)

PreferencesOutputConfig.description: Configuration for user preference collection and plist output

staticValues.description: Static key-value pairs to always include

PresetIntroScreen.description: Lightweight intro screen shown before the items view in Preset1/2. Reuses GuidanceContentView for rich content rendering.

content.description: Rich content blocks (text, bullets, info, etc.)

heroImage.description: Path, URL, 'sf=symbolname', or the literal 'computer' (case-insensitive) for the machine's own Mac-model image, which is checked before any path or symbol matching.

heroImageShape.description: Hero image shape. Defaults to 'none' on a bookend screen (a brand image shown whole), where a step's hero defaults to 'circle'.

showBackButton.description: Show back button (default: false — it's the first screen)

layout.description: Intro layout: 'overview' (hero band plus stat tiles), 'welcome' (centered greeting, app-icon strip and numbered steps) or 'explainer' (three illustrated Step 1-2-3 cards). Default: centered.

userBadge.description: overview layout: top-left pill text (e.g. enrollment email); avatar initials are derived from it

userBadgePosition.description: Where the identity chip sits; overview intro only, and only when userBadge is authored. 'bandLeading' (default) and 'bandTrailing' overlay the band; 'footerLeading' seats the chip before the footnote in the footer.

stats.description: overview layout: stat tiles. Values are config-authored; '{itemCount}' resolves to the live item count.

label.description: Caption below the figure ('apps to install')

state.description: Semantic state tinting this tile and its figure through the palette: 'ok', 'warning', 'error' or 'info', the status-badge vocabulary. Absent leaves the neutral surface.

footnote.description: overview/explainer layouts: small policy line, bottom-left. Supports {managed:<domain>:<key>|<fallback>} tokens, with the fallback shown when the profile is absent.

linkText.description: overview/welcome layouts: accent link — opens a popover listing the configured items

steps.description: welcome layout: numbered what-to-expect lines ({userName} substituted)

showAppIcons.description: welcome layout: show the icon preview strip built from the real item list (default: true)

explainerSteps.description: explainer layout: the three step cards. Built-in vignettes draw with the real configured item icons; 'image' overrides with a custom picture

explainerStepLabel.description: explainer layout: eyebrow format, {n} = 1-based card index (default 'Step {n}')

PresetSummaryScreen.description: Summary/bento screen shown after items complete in Preset1/2. Supports rich content and bento grid layouts.

itemStrip.description: Preset 4 finish page: the per-item strip of status dots and names. 'always' (default), 'never', or 'auto' (shown only while every name fits on one line).

bentoColumns.description: Grid columns. 2, the same as the bento step and the guidance block — one grid, one geometry, wherever its cells are authored.

bentoLayout.description: Bento arrangement. Not read on the summary screen, which uses bentoCells/bentoColumns/bentoRowHeight/bentoGap; the step-level key is read.

bentoRowHeight.description: Base row height in points. 140, matching the bento step and the guidance block.

heroImage.description: Path, URL, 'sf=symbolname', or the literal 'computer' (case-insensitive) for the machine's own Mac-model image, which is checked before any path or symbol matching.

heroImageShape.description: Hero image shape. Defaults to 'none' on a bookend screen (a brand image shown whole), where a step's hero defaults to 'circle'.

layout.description: Outro layout: 'dock' (Dock strip with installed app icons), 'receipt' (per-item results) or 'nextsteps' (hero plus action rows); default centered. Strings support {userName}, {managed:domain:key|fallback}, {itemCount}, {completedCount}, {failedCount} and {skippedCount}.

caption.description: dock layout: line under the picker (default explains the additive apply — picks are added to the Dock, everything else stays). Supports the usual tokens

infoNote.description: receipt layout: info banner above the footer (e.g. Self Service pointer)

linkText.description: Footer-left accent link — opens a popover listing the items with their final status

icon.description: Icon path/SF. Default: the icon of the item whose display name the row's title contains, else 'SF=app.fill'.

action.description: App path or URL opened by the Open button

dock.description: The grouped dock-picker spelling on a summary screen, folded onto the flat dock* keys at decode. Authoring both spellings is an error: the grouped value wins with an advisory.

dockMode.description: Dock-picker mode: 'flavors' (pick one preset dock, default) or 'build' (choose/order individual apps)

dockItems.description: Dock-picker (build mode): the candidate apps to choose/order

dockLayout.description: Dock-picker measure. 'narrow' selects the 560pt measure instead of the picker's default.

dockSelectionKey.description: Dock-picker: selection storage/emit key (falls back to the screen id). Emitted as dock:<key>:<ordered,paths>

dockPreferenceKey.description: Dock-picker: preferences-plist key for osquery/MDM output. Not read by the summary-screen dock.

dockConfirmButton.description: Dock-picker: confirm button text (nil = instant select)

dockApplyMode.description: Dock-picker: 'additive' (default) appends the chosen apps to the existing Dock, 'replace' rebuilds the Dock from them. swiftDialog does not change the Dock; it emits dock:<key>:<applyMode>:<paths> on the interaction log for a script to apply.

dockDecline.description: Dock-picker: the explicit 'change nothing' card. Omit for no decline option.

dockFlavors.description: dock layout: up to 3 prebuilt dock presets shown as flavor cards instead of individual app tiles. Pick one; the selection emits the flavor's ordered app paths.

recommended.description: Pre-select this Dock flavour so Continue is live on open. Same contract as optionCards[].recommended; a restored answer always wins over it.

ReceiptRow.description: One row of an outro receipt: one decision, changeable before Finish. The key list is closed because the Swift struct has no aliases.

stepId.description: An existing step; the Change action navigates to it.

selectionKey.description: Selection to display for this row

fallbackValue.description: Shown when the selection is empty

StepBase.description: Common properties for all step types

displayName.description: The short flow label the rail, sidebar and step list use for this step. 'title' is the screen heading.

guidanceTitle.description: Preset 6 item spelling of the step heading; folded onto 'title' at decode.

itemOverlay.description: Preset 6 item spelling of 'stepOverlay'; folded onto it at decode.

completedStatus.description: Label for this step once completed (Preset 6 item vocabulary).

observeOnly.description: Per-step observe-only override; cascades over the top-level observeOnly.

allowNavigationDuringProcessing.description: Whether Continue/Back stay live while this step processes.

stats.description: Facts in the seat of a 160pt vignette, as on the overview screen. Values are config-authored except '{itemCount}', which is resolved from live state.

backButtonKind.description: Provisioning shell: how the back door draws. 'text' is the word (default), 'chevron' the round plate (the closer's default).

screens.description: Sub-screens paged inside this step via the action-bar pager (chrome 'card'); the step keeps one position in the flow counter.

items.description: Rows inside this step. Not steps: a step carrying N of these leaves steps[], totalSteps and the rail count unchanged.

cadence.description: Gated message sequence that advances as each monitored attribute is satisfied. Either a bare entries array or the grouped payload carrying entries with style/interval/minDwell/ref. When 'cadenceRef' is also set and loadable, it wins and these entries are the fallback.

cadenceStyle.description: Cadence design: 'manifest' (default), 'spotlight' (one step at a time with recent receipts) or 'bento' (flip board). 'line', 'carousel', 'tiles', 'cards' and 'gates' are accepted and draw the manifest.

continueWhileRunning.description: How Continue behaves while a cadence or a card installation step is running: 'confirm' (default; live, with the confirmIncomplete sheet), 'hidden' or 'disabled'. Always live once nothing is installing or waiting, failures included.

cadenceInterval.description: How often the cadence engine re-evaluates its entries, in seconds. The chain is `cadenceInterval ?? monitorRefreshInterval ?? 0.6`; 0.6 matches `cadenceMinDwell`.

cadenceMinDwell.description: Default minimum seconds each cadence entry shows even when already satisfied (per-entry minDwell overrides)

cadenceRef.description: Read the cadence entries (CadenceEntry dicts) from a managed preference instead of inline 'cadence'. A loadable ref wins; inline entries are the fallback until the profile arrives. An unreadable ref logs a warning and falls back to inline entries.

brandColorRef.description: Read the cadence brand/tint colour (light + optional dark) from a managed preference

cardPanel.description: Right-hand panel of a card-chrome step: 'caption', 'stat', 'pairs' (label/value rows), 'image', 'video' (looping clip, overrides image), 'imageTitle', 'paragraphs', 'layout' ('max' = media fills the column). Media gives a screenshot frame, 'paragraphs' a reassurance card, otherwise a facts card.

carouselStyle.description: Which form a 'carousel' step renders: 'cards' (default) or 'manifest' (a list with one full line per claim and a metadata column, no paging). An unrecognised value falls back to 'cards'.

condition.description: Script or expression to evaluate for conditional display

content.description: Rich content blocks for the step

guidanceContent.description: Alias of 'content' (the ItemConfig spelling), folded onto 'content' at decode with an advisory.

continueAction.description: Action on continue: 'next', 'skip', 'portal', 'minimize' (miniaturize the window instead of advancing), or a custom script.

evaluation.description: Comparison for the plist condition. 'contains' is a case-folded substring match for a string value and exact membership for an array value; other scalars use their string form. No expectedValue means false.

expectedValue.description: Expected plist value for condition checking

footerNote.description: Outro footer note (Markdown), rendered in place of the step dots

gridPreferenceKey.description: Key to write selection to preferences plist

gridSelectionKey.description: Key to store grid selection in userValues

group.description: Consecutive steps sharing a group render under one heading in the rail. Absent = ungrouped.

headerIconTile.description: When true, the P6 content header draws 'heroImage' (into which 'icon' folds at decode) as a large rounded tile beside 'guidanceTitle'. Default false.

heroImage.description: Path to an image file, URL, SF=symbolName, or the literal 'computer' (case-insensitive) for the machine's own Mac-model image, which is checked before any path or symbol matching.

heroImagePadding.description: Inset padding in points (nil = auto ~4%%, 0 = none)

heroImageSFSymbolColor.description: Hex color for SF Symbol hero image (defaults to accentColor)

heroImageSFSymbolWeight.description: SF Symbol weight for hero image

heroImageShape.description: Hero image shape. 'none' when unauthored — the image is shown whole, as on a bookend. Author 'circle' for the badge look.

monitorRefreshInterval.description: Refresh interval in seconds for plist monitors (default 1.0). On a cadence step it also sets the poll interval when cadenceInterval is unset.

paths.description: Filesystem paths to check for existence

plistMonitors.description: Plist monitors for live content updates

receipt.description: Outro receipt: one row per decision, each changeable before Finish. Each row: 'stepId' (an existing step; Change navigates to it) and 'label', both required, plus optional 'selectionKey' (default stepId) and 'fallbackValue'. The answer is read from live selections at render time, never configured.

requireManualConfirm.description: When true, success:/failure: IPC commands update state but don't auto-advance. User must click to proceed.

selectable.description: Guide picker (pickerConfig): this step can be selected.

stepType.description: The step's renderer ('phase' says its role). Inferred at decode from the fields present ('installationMode' > 'wallpaperCategories' > 'optionCards' > 'dockFlavors'/'dockItems'); a conflicting value is overridden with an advisory. Values include 'portal', 'assistant', 'guide', 'cadence', 'deployment', 'carousel', 'showcase', 'bento', 'media', 'options', 'dock', 'wallpaper', 'installation' and 'splash'.

phase.description: The step's role in the flow, independent of its renderer: 'intro', 'main' (default) or 'outro'. Drives logo phase, the intro/outro filters and bundling. An 'intro'/'outro' authored in 'stepType' is moved here at decode.

completedTitle.description: cadence 'gates' only: title swap on completion (e.g. 'All prerequisites met'). Absent → the running 'title' stays; never a synthesized substitute.

failedTitle.description: cadence: title shown when a run stops (onTimeout 'halt'), e.g. 'A check didn't pass'. Absent, the running 'title' stays. Pairs with failureMessage.

completedMessage.description: cadence 'gates' only: claim line shown on completion (e.g. 'Three markers found. You're clear to continue.'). Absent, the claim renders blank on completion.

waitForExternalTrigger.description: Never auto-complete - wait for success:/failure: command

revisitable.description: Guided-setup: never auto-skip this step even when satisfied, so it can be re-opened repeatedly (default: false)

optionKey.description: Option-picker: selection storage/emit key (falls back to step id). Emitted as select:<key>:<value>

optionCards.description: Option-picker: the selectable cards (stepType 'options'). 'options' is the plain string list.

optionLayout.description: Option-picker layout (default: 'rows'). 'rows' is the decision arrangement: one full-width row per option, so cost lines are not truncated

optionConfirmButton.description: Option-picker: confirm button text (nil = instant select)

optionPreferenceKey.description: Option-picker: preferences-plist key for osquery/MDM output

dockMode.description: Dock-picker mode: 'flavors' (pick one preset dock, default) or 'build' (choose/order apps)

dockFlavors.description: Dock-picker (flavors mode): the preset docks to choose from

dockItems.description: Dock-picker (build mode): the candidate apps to choose/order

dockLayout.description: Dock-picker measure. 'narrow' selects the 560pt measure instead of the picker's default.

dockSelectionKey.description: Dock-picker: selection storage/emit key (falls back to step id). Emitted as dock:<key>:<ordered,paths>

dockPreferenceKey.description: Dock-picker: preferences-plist key for osquery/MDM output

dockConfirmButton.description: Dock-picker: confirm button text (nil = instant select)

dockDecline.description: An explicit 'change nothing' card shown after the flavours, rendered as a peer card in the grid. It emits a real answer, so a consumer can tell a decline from an unanswered step. Omit for no decline option.

label.description: e.g. 'Keep my Dock as it is'

subtitle.description: What declining means, e.g. 'Nothing added. You can pick a layout later in Self Service.'

dockApplyMode.description: Dock-picker: 'additive' (default) appends the chosen apps to the existing Dock, 'replace' rebuilds the Dock from them. swiftDialog does not change the Dock; it emits dock:<key>:<applyMode>:<paths> on the interaction log for a script to apply.

windowPosition.description: Reposition the window when this step appears (e.g. 'right' to slide aside for System Settings). Values match --position: left/right/center/topleft/etc. Restored to center on a later step that omits it.

windowPositionOffset.description: Optional edge offset in points for windowPosition

substeps.description: stepType 'substeps': gated in-page mini-wizard entries with dot progress

contentAnchor.description: Vertical content stance. 'top': pin the group to a fixed top offset so hero, title and subtitle hold position across steps. 'center': balanced spacers centre the group. P5/P6/P7 default to top; inherits the top-level contentAnchor when set.

contentAlign.description: Horizontal content stance. 'leading': title, copy and blocks run flush to the page margin and the measure goes full-bleed. 'center': the centred 480pt column. P5/P6/P7 default to leading; inherits the top-level contentAlign when set.

heroBadge.description: Green completion badge on the hero's top-trailing corner (outro variant of the one-design intro/outro pair).

showCadenceRecap.description: Outro steps: show the completed cadence's tile row and a summary line (pass count and duration). Only when the cadence completed in this launch.

totalTimeEstimate.description: One total cadence estimate in seconds; split evenly across entries without their own timeEstimate

autoCloseAfter.description: Visible footer countdown in seconds; at zero the dialog closes through the result-file path with exit 4 (auto-closed).

confirmIncomplete.description: Continue pressed while the step is unfinished asks before skipping (default true on cadence tiles/cards and card installation). false = skip silently.

secondaryButtonText.description: Plain-styled secondary beside the primary (58e's 'Not me'). Card arms only.

secondaryAction.description: What the secondary does; default back.

environments.description: Splash chooser destinations (chrome "splash"). Two or more turns the brand mark into a picker; fewer leaves the mark standing alone.

id.description: What the pick reports under environmentKey, e.g. "engineering". Absent: the title is reported.

subtitle.description: The line that tells an operator which one to pick, e.g. "For company-owned devices".

environmentLabel.description: Eyebrow above the splash chooser's destinations, e.g. "Deployment environment".

optionControl.description: Multi-select options on the provisioning shell: 'switch' draws each row as the card's sfSymbol and a trailing switch. Absent: a checkbox per row.

cadenceSelectionKey.description: The multi-select step whose resolved plan (picks plus includes, less cancels, stored as '<key>.run') this cadence step runs.
