A cadence step with no 'cadence' entries derives them from that step's cards (label, subtitle, sfSymbol, iconPath, runMessage, runOrder). Absent, the flow's only multi-select step is used.

cadenceTimeout.description: The timeout, in seconds, of each entry a cadence step derives from option cards; absent, 600.

reviewSelectionKey.description: stepType 'review': the multi-select step whose resolved plan this screen shows. Optional when the flow has exactly one multi-select step.

reviewAcknowledge.description: stepType 'review': an acknowledgement row, shown only when the plan holds an option with 'exposure'; Continue waits for it. Recorded as '<reviewSelectionKey>.acknowledged' = 'yes' (select:<key>.acknowledged:yes from a script).

environmentKey.description: Key the splash pick is reported under (default 'environment'): stdout `selection: <key> = <id>`, the event file's formValues and the result file. Reported when a door advances; the first destination when nothing was picked.

learnMoreText.description: Label for the link beneath the splash chooser's destinations; drawn only with learnMoreURL.

learnMoreURL.description: What the splash link shows inside the window, with Back to return: a web page, a video file, a YouTube, Vimeo or Loom link, an image, or a local path to any of these.

assistantImageHeight.description: Hero image area ratio 0.0-1.0 for assistant stepType

bentoColumns.description: Grid columns for the bento layout (default 2). A cell that starts at or past the last column draws nothing and is logged.

bentoGap.description: Gap between bento cells in points (default: 12)

bentoLayout.description: Bento layout: 'grid' (default), 'hero' (one hero cell over a supporting row) or 'summary' (one hero cell beside a stacked column). 'split' is an alias for 'grid'.

bentoRowHeight.description: Base row height in points for bento grid (default: 140)

bentoSidebarRatio.description: Sidebar width ratio for split mode

bentoTintColor.description: Base hex color for auto-tinting bento cells without explicit backgroundColor

bentoShowSlots.description: Print each cell's authored slot on it ('col 0 · row 1 · span 2x1 · 497pt') to find overlapping cells; overlaps are also logged. For authoring only.

autoAdvanceOnComplete.description: Auto-navigate to next step when all items complete

bannerHeight.description: Banner image height when heroImage is a file/URL (default: 100)

items.description: Inline items for self-contained installation steps

layout.description: 'grid': the journey rows as a horizontal card grid (artwork tile, name, state word, accent ring on the active card) instead of the checklist. Omit for the checklist.

stateWords.description: Per-step state words merged over the package vocabulary (Installed/Installing/Queued/Failed/Blocked/Removed), e.g. {"done": "Processed"}.

divisionMode.description: Division mode: the cards are this step's cadence entries, not one per app, and each stands for an equal share of the items in scope (8 cards, 20 items: a card completes every 2.5 items). Off (default): one card per item.

finalMessage.description: Division mode only. When set, the cards divide the items by whole shares and the remainder is a final stretch: after the last card this message shows until every item is processed, and only then is the primary button enabled. Absent, shares are fractional and the last card ends at the last item.

gridColumns.description: layout 'grid' only: how many cards share the row. 4 (default) is the page; 5 fits a five-card deck on one row with smaller tiles, and a deck of exactly that many never slides.

eyebrow.description: A short tag above the title, drawn in the accent as a chip by the setup-assistant content screens (layout 'features' / 'permissions').

gridStyle.description: layout 'grid' only. 'tile' (default): art tile above the name and state. 'glass': glyph, name and status in one glass tile, the active card ringed in the accent, with a progress track when gridProgress is set and the root supportText beneath.

gridProgress.description: layout "grid" only: draw a thin accent bar centred under the cards, completed items over total. Optional; off unless authored.

showGridCounter.description: layout 'grid', gridStyle 'glass': draw the header's 'N / M' counter (default true). Independent of showProgressLine.

showProgressLine.description: setup-assistant chrome: draw the footer's 'N of M <stateWords.done>' line (default true). When false the footer shows the authored footerNote. Independent of showGridCounter.

holdPrimary.description: Division mode only: decouples the primary door from finalMessage. 'disabled' holds the door shut while items remain; 'none' releases it even with a final message; 'hidden' draws no door while items remain and shows it enabled when the last one lands (the footer keeps its height). Absent, finalMessage alone gates the door.

progressFormat.description: Progress text template. Tokens (any style works): {completed}/{total}, $completed/$total, or %completed%/%total%. e.g. '{completed} of {total} steps completed'

autoAdvanceOnComplete.description: Auto-navigate to next step when all items complete

autoEnableButton.description: Disable Continue until all items complete (default: true)

autoEnableButtonText.description: Continue button text when all items complete (default: 'Done')

items.description: Inline items for self-contained installation steps

sideMessages.description: Messages that rotate in the step's content area, every sideMessageInterval seconds. A single string is read as a one-item list.

CadencePayload.description: The grouped cadence spelling. `entries` is the sequence; the siblings are the grouped forms of cadenceStyle/cadenceInterval/cadenceMinDwell/cadenceRef.

style.description: Which cadence design the step draws; the grouped spelling of 'cadenceStyle', folded onto it at decode. 'manifest' (default), 'spotlight' or 'bento'. 'line', 'carousel', 'tiles', 'cards' and 'gates' still decode and draw the manifest.

minDwell.description: Minimum seconds each entry shows even when already satisfied

WallpaperPayload.description: The grouped wallpaper spelling. Every member is its flat wallpaper* key with the prefix stripped; the two spellings decode to the same step.

OptionPayload.description: The grouped option-picker spelling (flat option* keys, prefix stripped).

DockPayload.description: The grouped dock-picker spelling (flat dock* keys, prefix stripped).

layout.description: Dock-picker measure. 'narrow' selects the 560pt measure instead of the picker's default.

applyMode.description: The grouped spelling of dockApplyMode: 'additive' (default) appends the chosen apps to the existing Dock, 'replace' rebuilds the Dock from them. swiftDialog does not change the Dock; it emits dock:<key>:<applyMode>:<paths> on the interaction log for a script to apply.

decline.description: The decline card (17c): 'Keep my Dock as it is'. Absent = no decline offered.

DeclineOption.description: An explicit 'change nothing' choice for a picker. It sits in the grid beside the alternatives and emits a real answer, so a consumer can tell an explicit decline from an unanswered step.

label.description: e.g. 'Keep my Dock as it is'

subtitle.description: What declining means, e.g. 'Nothing added. You can pick a layout later in Self Service.'

value.description: Value emitted when declining — lets a consumer tell an explicit decline from an unanswered step

MediaPayload.description: The grouped media spelling (flat media* keys, prefix stripped).

layout.description: 'viewer' (the multi-item default) lets the media own the window; 'split' forces the side-by-side.

stage.description: The viewer's stage ground: 'light' (default), 'surface', or any '#RRGGBB'.

BentoPayload.description: The grouped bento spelling (flat bento* keys, prefix stripped).

ShowcasePayload.description: The grouped showcase spelling (flat showcase* keys, prefix stripped).

SoftwarePayload.description: The grouped software spelling. `note` is the flat softwareNote.

agentLabel.description: Agent identity line ('agent: fleetctl'). Wins over `assistant.agentLabel` when both are authored.

ListItem.description: A row inside a step, not a step. Rows do not increment totalSteps, appear in the rail, or land in the emitted steps[].

claim.description: A note about what is happening to this item: present participle, one clause, under 40 characters ('Handing over the keys'). Distinct from `subtitle`, which says what the thing is.

size.description: Download size as a human string ("86 MB", "1.1 GB"). Authored, because nothing here can measure it.

version.description: Version per row ('142.0') — rows state version · size. Authored, like size.

timeEstimate.description: Rough install time in seconds. The install sidecar's Time-left sums these over unfinished rows (active row scaled by remaining fraction). An estimate only.

logAliases.description: Extra names this row answers to in log text, for lines that name the artefact (an installer filename) rather than the item. Distinct from `paths`, which prove installation on disk.

kind.description: The row shape, not a status. Absent = a plain row. 'info' renders no badge; 'confirmation' renders the checkbox that gates the footer; 'completion' renders the terminal summary row.

stepType.description: Deprecated on a row: 'info', 'confirmation' and 'completion' fold onto `kind` at decode. Any other value is inert.

status.description: A status icon name (e.g. 'shield', 'checkmark.circle.fill'), not a lifecycle state.

heroBackgroundColor.description: Hex colour for the hero image background, e.g. '#05164D'.

installationLayout.description: Layout for installation items. 'cards' is accepted and renders as 'list'.

installationMode.description: Transforms step into installation progress display

mediaFit.description: Media fill mode: 'fill' (crop) or 'fit' (show entire image)

mediaSide.description: Which side the media panel appears

showBackButton.description: Show the back button (default: true except on the first step). On a splash step it hides the defer door (backButtonText) and the deferral with it.

showProgressDots.description: Step dots at the bottom. Card-chrome footers draw them by default and false turns them off for this step; the standard intro draws them only when true.

showcaseGradientColors.description: Hex colors for gradient background (fallback: highlightColor)

showcaseTextColor.description: Hex color for overlay text (fallback: white 90%)

skipButtonText.description: Secondary button label left of Continue (e.g., 'Set Up Later')

guideText.description: Body copy for a guide step. Folded into `content` as a text block at decode; it is the one guide key configs author.

mediaHeight.description: Height of media carousel in points

mediaLayout.description: 'viewer': media owns the window (light stage, caption on the stage edge, pill pager); multi-item media steps default to it. 'split' forces the side-by-side layout.

mediaStage.description: The viewer's stage ground: 'light' (default), 'surface' (translucent panel wash) or any '#RRGGBB' for artwork authored against a brand colour.

allowOverride.description: Enable override capability for stuck processing

processingDuration.description: Countdown duration in seconds for processing step

processingMode.description: Processing mode: 'simple' auto-advances, 'progressive' waits for trigger

waitLargeOverrideTime.description: Show large 'Override' button after X seconds

waitSmallOverrideTime.description: Show small 'Skip' link after X seconds

mediaHeight.description: Height of media carousel in points

mediaLayout.description: 'viewer': media owns the window (light stage, caption on the stage edge, pill pager); multi-item media steps default to it. 'split' forces the side-by-side layout.

mediaStage.description: The viewer's stage ground: 'light' (default), 'surface' (translucent panel wash) or any '#RRGGBB' for artwork authored against a brand colour.

blockIndex.description: Index in guidanceContent array to update

downloadingStatus.description: Label for downloading items (default 'Installing…'). Preset 1 also builds its active section header from it, dropping the ellipsis.

getStartedSubtitle.default: Follow the steps to complete setup

progressFormat.description: Progress bar text format. Tokens (any style works): {completed}/{total}, $completed/$total, or %completed%/%total%

skippedStatus.description: Label for items not attempted (default: 'Skipped' — receipt outro rows and status popover)

removedStatus.description: Label for an item that had completed and whose path then disappeared (default 'Removed'). The row's state stays pending; the notice lasts 30 seconds, then the row shows the pending label.

skippedStatus.description: Label for items not attempted (default: 'Skipped' — receipt outro rows and status popover)

removedStatus.description: Label for an item that had completed and whose path then disappeared (default 'Removed'). The row's state stays pending; the notice lasts 30 seconds, then the row shows the pending label.

featured.description: Surface this collection first with a ★ (LEA-style featured section)

thumbnail.description: Optional thumbnail path (uses path if nil)

OptionCard.description: A selectable option card (browser / email / PDF / appearance / dock-flavor choice)

id.description: Card identifier (also the emitted value when 'value' is absent)

sfSymbol.description: SF Symbol glyph for the card

iconPath.description: Image or app-icon path (overrides sfSymbol; e.g. /Applications/Safari.app)

value.description: Value emitted on select (defaults to id)

dockPreview.description: Optional Dock preview shown under the label (dock-flavor cards).

preview.description: Built-in tile artwork, drawn rather than shipped: miniature desktops for the appearance choice, 'auto' for the light/dark split. Precedence: iconPath, then preview, then sfSymbol; an unknown name falls through to the icon. A card with a preview gets a 64pt art slot instead of 40pt.

effort.description: What choosing this costs the user (e.g. '~25 min · 1 restart')

exposure.description: What NOT choosing it costs the user (e.g. '3 days unpatched'); rendered in the warning tint

recommended.description: Marks the recommended option: badge and pre-selection. Exactly one card per picker; ignored on an unavailable card

recommendReason.description: Why it is recommended, in the user's terms (e.g. 'back soonest')

action.description: Optional action fired on commit, after the select: emit.

url.description: URL opened when action is 'url'; custom schemes such as fleet:// are supported

state.description: Availability of this option (omit for a plain selectable card). 'installed' = already on this Mac; 'pending' = installed later in the flow; 'unavailable' = shown but not selectable. Put the reason in 'subtitle'.

differentiator.description: Right-aligned measurable shown in its own column in 'layout: rows' (e.g. '12 GB', '340 GB', '—'). The column is dropped when no card has one.

category.description: Cards sharing a category render under one labelled band with a count, in first-seen order; absent = ungrouped. Grid/cards layouts, and a multi-select step's row sections on the provisioning shell.

includes.description: Multi-select: the options this one includes when picked. They show on and fixed ('Included in ...') and run without being picked. 'category:<name>' means every card in that category.

cancels.description: Multi-select: the options this one cancels when it runs. They show off and fixed ('Cancelled by ...') and do not run even if picked. A cancel beats an include. 'category:<name>' means every card in that category.

runOrder.description: Where this option runs when a progress step derives its entries from the cards: ascending, ties in card order, absent = 0.

runMessage.description: The line the derived progress shows while this option runs; absent, '<label>…'.

DockItem.description: A Dock app: label and absolute path, with an optional SF Symbol for the preview tile.

sfSymbol.description: Fallback glyph when no app icon is available

DockFlavor.description: A named preset dock ('flavor') — a curated ordered set of dock items

recommended.description: Pre-select this Dock flavour so Continue is live on open. Same contract as optionCards[].recommended; a restored answer always wins over it.

SubStep.description: One gated substep inside a 'substeps' step (icon/title/text + optional media + action)

mediaLayout.description: How media occupies the payload band. Absent means 'inline'.

media.description: Image or video path shown as a card

actionButtonText.description: Label for the per-substep action button

StepType_Portal.description: Properties specific to stepType 'portal' (web view, maximized): 44pt bar plus viewport plus 52pt footer, or full-bleed. The URL is always shown.

layout.description: 'bar' (default): a 44pt title bar with the step title, address and browser button, branded footer below. 'footer': no title bar; the footer carries the address. 'fullbleed' is accepted and means 'bar'.

source.description: Absolute or ~ path of the file or directory to copy

name.description: Display name override; default is the source's last path component

note.description: Annotation shown beside the name, e.g. '6 icons'

ExportPayload.description: The selection becomes files. Sizes are measured from the sources at render, never authored, and nothing is written until a button is pressed. Only detected editors are offered.

destination.description: Destination directory (~ expands). Created on write; same-named files inside are replaced.

editors.description: Candidate editor bundle ids in preference order, e.g. com.microsoft.VSCode

revealButtonText.description: Secondary action label (default 'Reveal in Finder'). Both actions write first.

StepType_Software.description: Properties specific to stepType: 'software' (software bundles). Apps are ordinary `items`; bundles group them by id.

layout.description: 'bundles': the catalogue as icon strips · 'detail': one bundle's apps as rows with the command shown · 'handoff': Self Service and URL-scheme launches.

bundles.description: Named groups. A bundle is a view over `items`, naming members by id, so detection, log-monitor routing and recheck apply unchanged.

summary.description: One line naming what is inside ('Figma, Adobe CC, fonts')

size.description: Download size as authored text ('6.8 GB'); never computed. Omit rather than estimate.

itemIds.description: Member item ids, in display order. An id with no matching item is dropped and logged, never drawn as a blank tile

command.description: The command the agent will run, shown verbatim — 'a background install that does not say what it runs is indistinguishable from something going wrong'

commandNote.description: Line under the command ('No admin password needed · the agent has the rights')

label.description: Button text. {missing}/{installed}/{total} are resolved from live detection.

action.description: request: emit a callback for the orchestrator (swiftDialog never installs) · app/url: launch

url.description: app: bundle id or path · url: the URL

requestId.description: request: id the orchestrator dispatches on

handoffs.description: layout 'handoff' (20d): Self Service / Ask IT cards (those with `detail`) and URL-scheme launch rows (those without)

bundleId.description: layout 'detail': which bundle this screen shows

softwareNote.description: Footnote ('Installs run in the background · you can close this window')

agentLabel.description: Agent identity line ('agent: fleetctl'). Rendered only when supplied — the dialog does not invent a liveness claim it cannot verify
